Topic.label: Figures with Line Symmetry and Reflection Symmetry Between Two Figures

Question: Which of the following figures must have line symmetry?
Solution: When an isosceles triangle is folded along the line containing the altitude to its base, the two sides coincide. A general parallelogram, right triangle, or trapezoid does not necessarily have an axis of symmetry.
